sections.section_title: FLASH write page protection for bank1 (FLASH_WRP1R_CUR)
sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.26 "FLASH write page protection for bank1 (FLASH_WRP1R_CUR)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 195.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0E8
Reset value: 0xXXXX XXXX
This register can be protected against unprivileged access when PRIV = 1
inFLASH_PRIVCFGR.
Default value: 0x0000 0000 (value in case of double ECC issue during OBL).
ST production value: refer to Table28: Option-byte organization
This read-only register reflects the current values of corresponding option bits.
Bits 31:0 WRPSG1[31:0]: Bank1 page protection option status byte
Each bit reflects the write protection status of the corresponding group of pages in Bank1.
0: Write protected
1: Not write protected
Note: Refer to Table29: Write-protection management for group definition.
